---

## Explanation

Every ordinary number appears 3 times
        ↓
each bit contributes 3, 6, 9, ... ones
        ↓
mod 3 = 0

Single number appears once
        ↓
its 1-bits contribute 1 extra
        ↓
mod 3 = 1
